key_plays: Q1 5:27: Tyler Bass made a 54-yard field goal to put Buffalo ahead 6-0.
Q2 13:23: Josh Allen threw a 4-yard touchdown pass to DJ Moore, extending Buffalo’s lead to 13-0.
Q2 3:48: James Cook III scored on a 1-yard run to make it 20-3.
Q2 1:45: Jacob Rodriguez intercepted Josh Allen and returned it 26 yards to the Buffalo 22; Miami later scored a field goal on the possession.
Q4 1:57: Tyler Bass made a 28-yard field goal to set the final score at 26-9.
content.storyline: Buffalo won 26-9, improving to 9-1 while Miami fell to 1-9. The Bills held the Dolphins to 185 total yards and no touchdowns.

recap.paragraph: James Cook III rumbled for a touchdown as the Bills beat the Dolphins 26-9! Tyler Bass kicked a 54-yard field goal to put Buffalo up 6-0. Josh Allen tossed a touchdown pass to DJ Moore. Cook then scored from 1 yard out to stretch the lead to 20-3. Miami snagged an Allen pass and kicked a field goal. But Buffalo's defense was mighty, holding Miami to no touchdowns! The win lifted the Bills to 9-1, while Miami fell to 1-9.
